gpu-ring.notes: Adds the medium size, with the ring beside a minute of history.

pc-stats.notes: Shows download and upload speed under the rings.

now-playing.notes: Long titles fade out instead of wrapping.

github-stars.notes: Uses a token when you give it one, for GitHub’s higher rate limit. Adds the large size.

hardware-temps.notes: Reads the GPU hot spot when there is one.
